state.seed_assertion: A DPIA must be carried out for processing activities based on indirect collection of personal data when it is not possible or feasible to guarantee the right of information in conjunction with at least one other criteria from the EDPB guidelines.

sentences.1: A DPIA must be carried out for processing activities based on indirect collection of personal data when it is not possible or feasible to guarantee the right of information in conjunction with at least one other criteria from the EDPB guidelines.
sentences.2: Processing activities based on indirect collection of personal data when it is not possible / feasible to guarantee the right of information in conjunction with at least one other criteria from the EDPB guidelines.
sentences.3: A DPIA is required for a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling.
sentences.4: A DPIA is required at least in the following cases: a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling
sentences.5: Systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling, on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person, is one type of processing that always requires a DPIA.
sentences.6: Article 35(3) sets out three types of processing which always require a DPIA: Systematic and extensive profiling with significant effects: "(a) any systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person."
sentences.7: A DPIA is required in the case of a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.
sentences.8: a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person
